entries.context:
$(while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do [ -f "$f" ] && wc -l < "$f" 2>/dev/null; done < <(_cr_reviewable_untracked) \
  | awk '{ sum += $1 } END { print sum+0 }')

$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard 2>/dev/null | grep -vE '^\.(claude|codex)/' \
    | while IFS= read -r f; do [ -f "$f" ] && wc -l < "$f" 2>/dev/null; done \
    | awk '{ sum += $1 } END { print sum+0 }')

$(while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do [ -f "$f" ] && wc -l < "$f" 2>/dev/null; done < <(_cr_reviewable_untracked) \
  | awk '{ sum += $1 } END { print sum+0 }')

$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard 2>/dev/null | grep -vE '^\.(claude|codex)/' \
    | while IFS= read -r f; do [ -f "$f" ] && wc -l < "$f" 2>/dev/null; done \
    | awk '{ sum += $1 } END { print sum+0 }')

$(while IFS="$(printf '\t')" read -r _fleet _proj _co _wt _root _common; do
      [ -f "$_root/package.json" ] || continue
      jq -r '.packageManager // empty' "$_root/package.json" 2>/dev/null || true
    done <"$TARGETS_TMP" | grep -oE 'pnpm@[0-9]+' 2>/dev/null | grep -oE '[0-9]+' 2>/dev/null | sort -u 2>/dev/null | tr '\n' ' ' 2>/dev/null || true)

jq -nc --arg p "$found" --arg a "$(CDPATH='' cd "$admin" && pwd -P)" '{path:$p, admin:$a}' \
            >> "$work/links.jsonl"

entries.command:
GIT_AUTHOR_NAME="$(rpc_ident "$release" author NAME)" \
    GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL="$(rpc_ident "$release" author EMAIL)" \
    GIT_AUTHOR_DATE="$(rpc_ident "$release" author DATE)" \
    GIT_COMMITTER_NAME="$(rpc_ident "$release" committer NAME)" \
    GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL="$(rpc_ident "$release" committer EMAIL)" \
    GIT_COMMITTER_DATE="$(rpc_ident "$release" committer DATE)" \
    git -c i18n.commitEncoding=UTF-8 commit-tree --no-gpg-sign "$tree" -p "$release" -F - <<EOF
entries.context:
$(
    GIT_AUTHOR_NAME="$(rpc_ident "$release" author NAME)" \
    GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL="$(rpc_ident "$release" author EMAIL)" \
    GIT_AUTHOR_DATE="$(rpc_ident "$release" author DATE)" \
    GIT_COMMITTER_NAME="$(rpc_ident "$release" committer NAME)" \
    GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL="$(rpc_ident "$release" committer EMAIL)" \
    GIT_COMMITTER_DATE="$(rpc_ident "$release" committer DATE)" \
    git -c i18n.commitEncoding=UTF-8 commit-tree --no-gpg-sign "$tree" -p "$release" -F - <<EOF
$message
EOF
  )
